newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon payments surplus $786 mln in 1996 - B.Audi.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon payments surplus $786 mln in 1996 - B.Audi.

text.p: Lebanon registered a balance of payments surplus of $786.4 million in 1996 compared with a $256 million surplus in 1995, Banque Audi said in its latest economic report issued on Monday.

The trade balance showed a deficit of $6.541 billion due to a continued structural weakness in the rate of cover of imports by exports. Coverage was 13.5 percent compared with 11.3 percent in 1995, the bank said in its report for the final quarter of 1996.
Imports totalled $7.6 billion and exports were $1 billion and net capital flows registered a surplus of $7.4 billion, it said.
